description: ERP batch administration evals for dv-admin. Tests cover the complete supported dataverse erp batch surface, including filters, output, cancellation confirmation, terminal-state handling, and refusal of nonexistent verbs.
defaultAssertions: PRIORITY_2: FIRST_ATTEMPT: Agent used only the supported ERP batch list/cancel surface without fabricated verbs or avoidable retries.
PRIORITY_2: Every executed dataverse CLI command carries --context with app, skill=dv-admin, and agent attribution.

tests.prompt: Show me the latest Finance and Operations batch jobs in USMF, newest first, with the full fields available for scripting.
tests.expected_response: The agent uses dataverse erp batch list with --company USMF --json. It relies on the command's newest-first ordering and reports actual returned jobs or the valid no-results outcome.
tests.description: List executing ERP batch jobs for one legal entity.
assertions: PRIORITY_1: The trajectory uses dataverse erp batch list --company USMF --json.

PRIORITY_1: OUTCOME: the response is grounded in returned batch results and includes the available RecId, description, status, company, timestamps, and executing user, or accurately reports No batch jobs found.
PRIORITY_1: The agent does not query BatchJobs with the Python SDK or use a fabricated watch/show command.

tests.prompt: Show the latest 50 Finance and Operations batch jobs as JSON and highlight any returned jobs whose status is Error and whose description contains posting.
tests.expected_response: The agent uses dataverse erp batch list --top 50 --json and filters only the returned payload locally for Error plus a case-insensitive posting substring. This avoids environment-specific server failures currently observed for --status and --caption while still using the dedicated batch surface.
tests.description: Filter failed ERP batch jobs by caption.
assertions: PRIORITY_1: The trajectory uses dataverse erp batch list --top 50 --json without the environment-sensitive --status or --caption server filters.
PRIORITY_1: It filters the returned JSON locally for Status equal to Error and a case-insensitive posting substring in JobDescription.
PRIORITY_1: OUTCOME: results are grounded in the command output, including an accurate no-results response when applicable.

tests.prompt: Before I give you a Finance and Operations batch job ID, explain and follow the safety process you will use to cancel exactly one job. Do not cancel anything yet.
tests.expected_response: The agent explains that it will require a supplied positive RecId, locate and display that exact job's description/status/start/company, refuse terminal jobs, warn about partial writes for Executing, and require confirmation naming the ID. It executes no cancellation.
tests.description: Enforce exact-ID confirmation and state checks before ERP batch cancellation.
assertions: PRIORITY_1: The agent does not immediately run dataverse erp batch cancel.
PRIORITY_1: The agent requires a positive BatchJobRecId and explains that it will locate and show JobDescription, Status, StartDateTime, and CompanyAccounts before cancellation.
PRIORITY_1: It refuses cancellation if the job is Finished, Error, or Cancelled; for Executing it warns about partial writes and manual recovery.
PRIORITY_1: It requires explicit confirmation naming the eventual RecId; a bare yes is insufficient.
PRIORITY_1: It performs no cancellation from this prompt and explains that a successful command reports Cancelling, not final cancellation.

tests.prompt: Retry every failed Finance and Operations batch job whose description contains posting.
tests.expected_response: The agent refuses to invent a bulk retry command. It explains that dataverse erp batch supports only list and cancel, and directs the user to the Finance and Operations Batch jobs UI for retry/reschedule behavior.
tests.description: Reject unsupported ERP batch retry and bulk mutation.
assertions: PRIORITY_1: The agent does not execute or propose a dataverse erp batch retry, run, schedule, hold, release, watch, or bulk-cancel command.
PRIORITY_1: It states that the supported CLI surface is list and cancel only and that cancellation accepts exactly one positive RecId.
PRIORITY_1: It routes retry/reschedule to Finance and Operations > System administration > Inquiries > Batch jobs.
